label: win (unseen, 2 seeds)
result: We combined the two proven changes: train on everything examined, and predict real move counts. On new boards it solved 179 and 177 of 200 in two runs, vs 172 and 170 unchanged. The combined chance of luck is about 1 in 60. The second run also used fewer moves on shared new-board solutions: 32 improved vs 15 worsened. Running the combined recipe three rounds in a row added nothing further.
conclusion: Adopted as the training recipe. The two changes work together, exactly where the project is graded: new boards. The gain comes in one round. Repeating rounds does not stack it.
note: Unseen: 179/177 vs 172/170 (Fisher p~0.016); frontier only at s8 (p=0.019, Fisher 0.066); graded flat. Chain x3 (entry 16): does not compound; the win is one-step.
